mechanism_narrative: A sustained monthly increase in real personal consumption expenditures (RSAFS) signals robust consumer demand, directly supporting corporate revenue growth and driving positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days without regime dependence.
failure_condition: SPX 20-day returns are negative in more than 55% of months with RSAFS growth exceeding 0.3% month-over-month, or Rank IC falls below 0.02 over any 3-year rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: A declining unemployment rate (UNRATE) reflects tightening labor market conditions that boost consumer spending and corporate profit margins, generating positive S&P 500 returns over the next 20 trading days regardless of economic cycle phase.
failure_condition: SPX 20-day returns are negative in over 55% of months with UNRATE falling by more than 0.2 percentage points, or the Rank IC is below 0.02 in any 3-year window.

mechanism_narrative: When the Federal Funds rate (FEDFUNDS) exceeds 4.5%, it signals restrictive monetary policy that increases equity discount rates and reduces valuations, causing negative S&P 500 returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 20-day returns are positive in more than 55% of months with FEDFUNDS above 4.5%, or the Rank IC is below 0.02 over any 2-year rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: A sustained decline in industrial production (INDPRO) below 100 (index 2017=100) for two consecutive months signals economic contraction, leading to negative S&P 500 returns over the next 60 trading days as corporate activity weakens.
failure_condition: SPX 60-day returns are positive in more than 55% of months meeting the INDPRO trigger, or the Rank IC is below 0.02 over any 3-year window.

mechanism_narrative: A simultaneous decline in industrial production (INDPRO) and rise in unemployment (UNRATE) indicates severe economic slowdown, triggering negative S&P 500 returns over the next 20 trading days due to reduced corporate earnings and heightened risk aversion.
failure_condition: SPX 20-day returns are positive in more than 55% of instances where INDPRO falls and UNRATE rises, or the interaction effect (measured by Rank IC) is not significant (p>0.05) in any 3-year rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: During monetary tightening cycles (FEDFUNDS rising), a decline in real personal consumption expenditures (RSAFS) signals reduced consumer demand, leading to negative S&P 500 returns over the next 20 trading days as policy restraint weakens economic momentum.
failure_condition: SPX 20-day returns are positive in more than 55% of months during monetary tightening cycles with RSAFS decline, or the Rank IC for RSAFS in tightening cycles is below 0.02.

mechanism_narrative: In late-cycle expansions (high GDP growth and low unemployment), a decline in industrial production (INDPRO) signals fading growth momentum, causing negative S&P 500 returns over the next 60 trading days as economic slowdown risks materialize.
failure_condition: SPX 60-day returns are positive in more than 55% of months during late-cycle expansions with INDPRO decline, or the Rank IC for INDPRO in late-cycle is below 0.02.

mechanism_narrative: A simultaneous increase in CPI (CPIAUCSL) and decline in industrial production (INDPRO) indicates stagflation, eroding corporate margins and investor confidence, leading to negative S&P 500 returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 20-day returns are positive in more than 55% of instances with CPIAUCSL rising and INDPRO falling, or the interaction effect (Rank IC) is not significant (p>0.05) in any 3-year window.
